stem.text: A ball is kicked upwards at an angle of $45^{\circ}$ to horizontal ground. After a short flight, the ball returns to the ground.
It may be assumed that air resistance is negligible.
What is **never** zero during the flight of the ball?

A.text: the horizontal component of the ball’s acceleration

B.text: the horizontal component of the ball’s velocity

C.text: the vertical component of the ball’s momentum

D.text: the vertical component of the ball’s velocity
